summary.root_cause_text: payment_provider_url was changed live (no deploy, not in recent_changes) from internal://payments-v1 to internal://payments-v2, which is unreachable, so the worker processed orders without recording payments.
recommended: Find out who changed payment_provider_url to payments-v2 and why. Confirm that endpoint is reachable before any migration.
Alert on payment provider call failures, which are logged only at DEBUG.
Record config changes in the change log.
